numeric_policy.observations: SOURCED; point observation L=B=H refers only to cited artifact, not statistical uncertainty; raw status counts/file metadata inherit exact source hashes.
numeric_policy.estimates: ASSUMPTION low/base/high; no intervals are claimed to have statistical coverage.
numeric_policy.unknowns: null = HUMAN_INPUT/UNMEASURED, not zero; exact IDs/dates/schema ordinals are identifiers.
numeric_policy.scoring: Ordinal 0–4 rubric, low/base/high judgment sensitivity. No weighted sum; cannot compensate failed gates. Upper bands A<=3, B<=2, D<=3: uninspected or missing acceptance and matched-benefit evidence cannot establish the corresponding higher rubric level.
